sponsored.t: Relates to electronic service of process
sponsored.sum: Permits process to be served electronically by certain entities on the secretary of state for certain purposes.

sponsored.t: Repeals certain provisions relating to voting by members of the New York state authorities control board
sponsored.sum: Relates to voting by members of the New York state authorities control board.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "prevention of damage to critical infrastructure act of 2026"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "prevention of damage to critical infrastructure act"; prevents junk dealers and scrap processors from selling metals that are used by critical infrastructure providers; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Relates to civil penalties imposed by the public service commission upon certain utility corporations
sponsored.sum: Requires that any sanction or civil penalty imposed by the public service commission be returned to the rate payers by means of a direct bill credit, as soon as practically feasible or no later than ninety days.

sponsored.t: Increases the period of supervision required for certain real estate license applications
sponsored.sum: Increases the period of supervision to four years for real estate brokers applying for a license.

sponsored.t: Ensures the public has virtual access to public service commission proceedings and may file documents electronically
sponsored.sum: Ensures the public has virtual access to public service commission proceedings and may file documents electronically.

sponsored.t: Relates to rulings on motions and petitions in proceedings before the public service commission
sponsored.sum: Provides deadlines for rate and non-rate cases before an administrative law judge or judges, the secretary to the public service commission and the public service commission.

sponsored.t: Relates to settlement negotiations in major electric, natural gas, water, and steam rate increase proceedings before the public service commission
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of public service to assign an administrative law judge to preside over all rate case settlement negotiations.

sponsored.t: Allows issues before the public service commission to be determined publicly rather than through settlement discussions not open to the public
sponsored.sum: Provides that in any rate proceeding, any party may seek to sever from consideration in the settlement process or inclusion in any joint proposal any substantive issue that it discussed in its direct testimony.

sponsored.t: Relates to the review of joint proposals in rate proceedings
sponsored.sum: Requires both the department of public service staff and the utility to provide separate, substantive responses to discovery requests and cross-examination questions seeking evidence or explanations related to elements of the joint proposal and explain how any contested aspect of the joint proposal delivers outcomes for utility consumers that are in compliance with all applicable laws and are at least as favorable as would have resulted had its testimonial position been approved by the public service commission.

sponsored.t: Relates to protection of underground facilities, mandatory standards for newly installed underground facilities, excavator training and certification, and damage reporting
sponsored.sum: Establishes standards for newly installed underground facilities related to locatability and mapping; defines terms; requires the public service commission to establish implementation schedules for locatability and as-built location information.

sponsored.t: Relates to nursing transition and diversion
sponsored.sum: Provides that services provided to persons qualifying for nursing home diversion and transition services shall not be provided to medical assistance recipients through managed care programs.

sponsored.t: Establishes a procedure for appointing a president or chairperson upon a vacancy of such position
sponsored.sum: Establishes a procedure for appointing a president or chairperson upon a vacancy of such position.

sponsored.t: Includes contacts via text, email, private message, direct message or other electronic communication in the definition of the offense of aggravated harassment in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Includes contacts via text, email, private message, direct message or other electronic communication in the definition of the offense of aggravated harassment in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to major renovations or alterations to a cemetery
sponsored.sum: Requires the approval of a cemetery board before a major renovation or major alteration and upon submission of a report by the cemetery; requires certain information about applications and permits be included in such report; requires any report submitted for a major renovation or major alteration expected to cost in excess of $250,000 be certified by a licensed engineer, architect or landscape architect; changes the due date for each cemetery corporation's report from March 15th to April 15th.

sponsored.t: Relates to administrative law judges overseeing the process certain policy proceedings
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of public service to assign an administrative law judge to oversee the process in policy proceedings before the public service commission; provides that the department of public service shall be considered a party in policy proceedings.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a tax abatement for alterations and improvements to multiple dwellings for purposes of preserving habitability in affordable housing
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a tax abatement for alterations and improvements to multiple dwellings for purposes of preserving habitability in affordable housing.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the retention of any amount of payment due and owing for materials delivered and accepted for a public or private construction project
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the retention of any amount of payment due and owing for materials delivered and accepted for a public or private construction project.

sponsored.t: Relates to the failure of certain utilities and the Long Island power authority to achieve annual customer service performance targets
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "utility penalty and customer bill relief act"; requires every gas corporation, electric corporation, combination gas and electric corporation, water-works corporation and the Long Island power authority which fails to achieve annual customer service performance targets in a particular year, which are subject to financial penalties or negative revenue adjustments to return such penalties or adjustments to rate payers as a direct bill credit.

sponsored.t: Establishes prescribed pediatric extended care centers
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to establish and administer a program for the certification, operation, and oversight of two prescribed pediatric extended care centers to provide supportive services to medically stable and medically complex children who require continual care.

sponsored.t: Relates to hospitalization, care coordination, and assisted outpatient treatment for persons with mental illness
sponsored.sum: Relates to hospitalization, care coordination, and assisted outpatient treatment for persons with mental illness.

sponsored.t: Relates to the perimeter rule at LaGuardia airport
sponsored.ls: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey
sponsored.sum: Provides that the port authority shall prohibit nonstop flights to or from points beyond one thousand five hundred miles, except on Saturdays and flights to Denver, Colorado, from flying to or from LaGuardia airport, an air terminal of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey.

sponsored.t: Creates an excise tax on the collection of consumer data by commercial data collectors
sponsored.sum: Creates an excise tax on the collection of consumer data by commercial data collectors.

sponsored.t: Requires certain text-books to reference the Sea of Japan as also the East Sea
sponsored.sum: Requires all text-books approved by this article to reference the Sea of Japan as also the East Sea.

sponsored.t: Relates to the treatment of cooperative housing entities
sponsored.sum: Provides that the term "landlord" when used in the real property law, shall not include or apply to any corporation, entity or organization, hereinafter known as a "cooperative entity" that is or is operating for the purpose of providing housing and/or residences for its shareholders by leasing or subleasing to such shareholders, under proprietary leases or occupancy agreements or subleases of such leases or occupancy agreements of apartments or residences in the buildings or premises owned by such cooperative entities; makes related provisions for the term "tenant".

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing an abatement and exemption from real property taxes for capital improvements to reduce carbon emissions
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing an abatement and exemption from real property taxes for capital improvements to reduce carbon emissions; establishes an energy efficiency improvement board to approve the abatements and exemptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to a threat to share an intimate image
sponsored.sum: Establishes that when an actor threatens to disseminate or publish a still or video image depicting such other person with one or more intimate parts exposed or engaging in sexual conduct with another person, including a still or video image created or altered by digitization, where such person may reasonably be identified from the still or video image itself or from information displayed in connection with the still or video image within the provisions of unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York small contractor relief act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York small contractor relief act"; defines terms; authorizes a small contractor captive insurance company to purchase, and the New York state insurance fund shall be authorized and directed to provide, reinsurance and retrocession reinsurance for such captive insurance company, on either a quota share arrangement or facultative arrangement at a rate to be determined by the board of the fund; provides that a small contractor captive insurance company organized pursuant to this article shall not refuse to issue, renew or cancel a policy of any qualified small construction contractor based upon geographic location or line of business engaged in by such contractor; makes related…

sponsored.t: Directs the department of public service to prepare a written report on the affordability of water services for commercial and residential customers
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of public service to prepare a written report on the affordability of water services for commercial and residential customers within 180 days of effectiveness; requires an updated report to be submitted one year after the initial report.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment and the reporting of residential water cost indexes
sponsored.sum: Requires the public service commission to develop a formula for the calculation of a residential water cost index; requires each water-works corporation and municipal water system serving one thousand customers or more to calculate and submit to the public service commission its residential water cost index; requires the public service commission to publish a report on the residential water cost index of each applicable water-works corporation and municipal water system.

sponsored.t: Clarifies how certain non-billing information regarding the delivery of water is disclosed to residents of cooperatives, condominiums or multi-family dwellings
sponsored.sum: Clarifies how certain non-billing information regarding the delivery of water is disclosed to residents of cooperatives, condominiums or multi-family dwellings; requires water-works corporations to notify customers of their ability to receive non-billing related information.

sponsored.t: Relates to the receipt of catalytic converters by junk dealers and scrap dealers
sponsored.sum: Places limitations on transactions involving the sale of catalytic converters to junk dealers, junk yard owners or operators, or scrap metal processors or scrap metal processing facilities; relates to record keeping relating to transactions involving the sale of catalytic converters.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York city transit authority and metropolitan transportation authority to ensure the proper operation of security cameras at subway stations and report thereon
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York city transit authority and metropolitan transportation authority to ensure the proper operation of security cameras at subway stations and report thereon.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring a medical facility or related services to obtain express prior written consent before the making and/or broadcasting of visual images of a patient's medical treatment
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring a medical facility or related service to obtain express prior written consent before filming and/or broadcasting of visual images of a patient's medical treatment.

sponsored.t: Relates to project applications and advisory opinions of the public authorities control board
sponsored.sum: Relates to project applications and advisory opinions of the public authorities control board; requires that any application made concerning a proposed project involving a loan, to the extent practicable, shall include the terms, conditions and dates of the repayment of state appropriations; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes the temporary state commission on New York city property tax reform
sponsored.sum: Establishes the 13 member temporary state commission on New York city property tax reform to propose property tax reform for the city of New York that promotes fairness, clarity, and simplicity; that eliminates structural inequality and taxes similar properties similarly; that encourages the development and preservation of affordable and multifamily housing; that includes owner relief programs and an approach to transition that insures low- and moderate-income owners have affordable tax bills and that primary residents are not displaced from their homes; and that does not diminish revenue for the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disqualification of a surviving spouse
sponsored.sum: Provides for the disqualification of a surviving spouse if the marriage is annulled or voided after the death of the spouse.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain dry cleaning equipment or machinery certified by the department of environmental conservation from sales and use taxes
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain dry cleaning equipment or machinery certified by the department of environmental conservation from sales and use taxes.

sponsored.t: Adds tianeptine sodium to the list of Schedule II of controlled substances
sponsored.sum: Adds tianeptine sodium to list of Schedule II of controlled substances.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing municipalities to accept retroactive applications for real property tax exemptions from certain veterans
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing municipalities to accept retroactive applications for real property tax exemptions from certain veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to labeling prescription bottles of opioids
sponsored.sum: Requires prescription bottles containing opioids to have a label affixed concerning the addictive nature of the drug.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding W-18 to the schedule of controlled substances
sponsored.sum: Adds W-18 (4-chloro-N-{1-{2-(4-nitrophenyl)ethyl}2piperidinylidene}benzenesulfonamide) to the schedule of controlled substances.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the display of a notice of responsibilities to protect underground facilities
sponsored.sum: Provides any entity which leases excavation equipment to the public with the telephone number of the system and a sample or model notice informing lessees of excavation equipment of the system and their responsibilities relating to the protection of underground facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing the salary of the chair of NYSERDA
sponsored.sum: Removes the salary of the chair of NYSERDA; allows the chair to engage in private employment.

sponsored.t: Relates to the court approval process for the sale, mortgage and lease of real property of a religious corporation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the court approval process for the sale, mortgage and lease of real property of the Greek Orthodox Archdiocese of America.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of law relating to the acquisition and disposition of real property by the metropolitan transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law relating to the acquisition and disposition of real property by the metropolitan transportation authority.

sponsored.t: Increases the period of supervision required for certain real estate license applications
sponsored.sum: Increases the period of supervision to five years for real estate brokers applying for a license.

sponsored.t: Relates to the ability to issue certain bonds and notes
sponsored.ls: New York State Medical Care Facilities Finance Agency Act
sponsored.sum: Allows the New York state medical care facilities finance agency to issue one billion eight hundred thousand dollars more of certain bonds and notes.
